lines.zh: 它迈着沉重而有节奏的步子
lines.en: It walks with heavy, steady strides.
Its broad body parts the brush.

lines.zh: 它的前腿比后腿短一些
lines.en: Its forelegs are shorter than the hind.

lines.zh: 粗重的身子压过蕨丛，一路作响。
lines.en: My heavy bulk crushes through ferns, loud all the way.
It walks the edge of the clearing.

lines.zh: 每走几步它就抬一次头
lines.en: Every few steps it lifts its head.

lines.zh: 它踩过蕨丛，把它们压平
lines.en: It tramples the ferns flat.

lines.zh: 它在自己的领地上巡行
lines.en: It patrols its own ground.
Its shadow moves between the trees.

lines.zh: 它走到一棵大树前停下
lines.en: It stops before a large tree.
It rubs its shoulder on the bark.

lines.zh: 它转身，走回原来的方向
lines.en: It turns and walks back the way it came.
Its steps push pebbles aside.
It dips its head to sniff a tuft.
It climbs a gentle slope.
Its breathing grows heavy.
It stands a long while at the top.

lines.zh: 然后它往下走，步子更稳
lines.en: Then it descends, more sure-footed.

lines.zh: 它站着，四肢撑得稳稳的
lines.en: It stands square on all fours.

lines.zh: 它慢慢咀嚼着嘴里的草
lines.en: It chews the grass in its mouth.
Its nose twitches twice.

lines.zh: 它把头转向风来的方向
lines.en: It turns its head into the wind.
The skin folds on its back shift.

lines.zh: 它抬起一只前脚，又放下
lines.en: It lifts a forefoot and sets it down.

lines.zh: 它把额头在树干上蹭了蹭
lines.en: It rubs its brow on a trunk.
Its tail sways slowly.
It snorts suddenly.
It lowers its head back to the grass.

lines.zh: 小虫落在它背上，它没理
lines.en: Insects land on its back; it ignores them.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸声像远处的鼓
lines.en: Its breathing is like a distant drum.
It turns its flank to the sun.
It holds still, eyes half closed.
It raises its head, heavy-eyed.
It squares itself to you.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，鼻息喷在你靴子上。
lines.en: I lift my head and snort onto your boots.
It takes half a step forward.
Its eyes do not blink.

lines.zh: 它低头嗅了嗅你的方向
lines.en: It lowers its head and sniffs toward you.
Its tail stops swinging.
Its hoof scrapes the ground.

lines.zh: 它没有敌意，只是不许靠近
lines.en: No attack, but no approach either.
It gives a low rumble.
Hurt, it gives half a step.
It gives a low, deep call.
It pulls the young in closer.
Its breathing turns heavy.

lines.zh: 厚皮上留下了一道血痕
lines.en: A blood line shows on its thick hide.
Its hoof scrapes twice.
It slowly squares itself.
It does not run, only grows fiercer.
It turns to look at the wound.
It takes up the path again.
It comes for the grass you hold.
It lowers its head and takes the grass.
It chews slowly and loudly.
Fed, it still will not leave.
Its big head bumps your hand.
It licks sap from its lips.
It glances back at its young.

lines.zh: 它把草料让了一份出去
lines.en: It yields part of the feed.
It huffs out a contented breath.
It keeps grazing.
You hit it and it barely shifts.

lines.zh: 它侧了侧身，把你让出去
lines.en: It angles aside to let you by.
Its shoulder pushes you back.
It shifts its weight across.
Its tail sweeps past your knee.
It looks down to check you.
It gives half a step and plants itself.

lines.zh: 它的皮褶蹭了你的手臂
lines.en: Its hide folds brush your arm.

lines.zh: 它不太高兴地哼了一声
lines.en: It grunts, not best pleased.
But it goes no further.

lines.zh: 两只并排走着，步调一致
lines.en: Two walk abreast, in step.
It rubs its head against the other's neck.
They keep the young between them.
Their breathing nearly syncs.

lines.zh: 它挡在幼崽和外面之间
lines.en: It stands between the young and the world.
Together they give a low call.
Their shadows overlap.

lines.zh: 它把最好的草让给对方
lines.en: It yields the best grass to its mate.
They stand head to head.
The wood is quiet for now.

lines.zh: 它用舌头把草叶卷起来
lines.en: Its tongue curls the grass up.
It pins the food down and bites.
It drags the bundle of grass over.
It sniffs before deciding.

lines.zh: 它把不合口的踩到一边
lines.en: What it rejects, it tramples aside.

lines.zh: 它把食物留给身后的幼崽
lines.en: It leaves the food for the young behind it.
It eats slowly and wastes nothing.
It keeps the rest underfoot.
Afterward it licks its nose.
It lifts its head and resumes patrol.
It drops its head suddenly.
It turns broadside to block the way.
Its forehoof scrapes the dirt.
Its breathing turns rough.
It drives the young behind itself.

lines.zh: 它发出一声短促的警告
lines.en: It gives a short warning.
Its shoulders bunch.
It presses one slow step forward.
Its tail lifts.

lines.zh: 它把这条路当成自己的
lines.en: It counts this path as its own.
It does not charge yet.

lines.zh: 林间空地是我的，蹄子开始刨土。
lines.en: This glade is mine; my hooves start pawing dirt.
It stands between you and the young.
It moves with you, always blocking.
It paws the ground now and then.

lines.zh: 它用头顶朝你的方向晃
lines.en: Its head swings toward you.
It tries half a step and stops.
Its breathing grows louder.
Its tail stays up.
It is driving you toward the boundary.
It is counting your steps.
Back off, and it will not follow.
It halts, waiting on your choice.
It guides the young behind a tree.
It fills the gap with its body.
It lowers its head and rams.
Its skull hits your chest.
A forehoof strikes your leg.

lines.zh: 它的肩把你顶退好几步
lines.en: Its shoulder shoves you back several steps.

lines.zh: 它尾巴一甩，抽在你腰上
lines.en: Its tail whips across your waist.
It bites your sleeve.

lines.zh: 它撞完立刻退回幼崽前
lines.en: It strikes and returns to the young.
There is real weight in it.
It bites air; the teeth clash.
It presses you with its whole bulk.
It grunts and charges again.

lines.zh: 它停在半步之外，给你机会
lines.en: It stops half a step short, giving you a chance.
The brush parts in a line.
It walks out of the trees.
Its broad shoulders bend the branches.
It stops and scans the clearing.
Two young follow behind it.
It calls softly.
Its steps crackle on the ground.
It heads for the nearest fern patch.
It lowers its head and begins to eat.
It grazes with its eyes coming up.

lines.zh: 它的影子很宽，压住草地
lines.en: Its wide shadow presses on the grass.

lines.zh: 背上备着鞍，可方向得听木棍的。
lines.en: Saddled, but the stick decides my heading.
It shows no intention of leaving.

lines.zh: 它把幼崽往身后拢了拢
lines.en: It gathers the young behind itself.

lines.zh: 然后它看着你，一动不动
lines.en: Then it watches you, motionless.
Its tail rises slowly.
Singed hide sends it wheeling about.

lines.zh: 落地时它的腿弯了一下
lines.en: It lands and its legs fold a moment.

lines.zh: 水淹过鼻子，它奋力抬头
lines.en: Water closes over its nose; it fights upward.

lines.zh: 冲击把它推得侧滑出去
lines.en: The blast skids it sideways.
An arrow buries in its shoulder.
Odd force makes its whole frame shudder.

lines.zh: 饿得肋骨顶起皮，草根也要嚼。
lines.en: Hunger lifts my ribs through the hide; I chew roots.

lines.zh: 雷击让它四肢发麻，跪了下来
lines.en: Lightning numbs its legs; it kneels.

lines.zh: 虚空拖它，四蹄拼命抠地
lines.en: The void pulls; all four hooves dig in.
